items.title: Dalton Richards Interview, 1961-03-16
items.q: Kimball. [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, we haven't interviewed him yet, we must see him. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, Kimball. Another fella that plays trumpet too, used to find him, Gilbert.

ctx.x: He's playing with Fat Domino now.

A little short fella, he's playing bass with Fat Domino. Boy, he was a terrific bass player and a terrific help to me. He could stand right here, and after I played a few boards of a number, he said, next time you come around here, I want to tell you something. So, he said, now, instead of you making straight D, change the position and make it D minor. Let your F be right in the middle. I mean, all those kind of things he was telling you. Hear all those things. And he knew I could do it, because he told me, oh,…
Yeah, we haven't interviewed him yet, we must see him.
